You can’t go home again, writes Thomas C. Wolfe in Look Homeward, Angel. Paris-based artist Aho Ssan (Niamké Désiré) experienced this feeling of disconnection when he visited Ghana, his ancestral home. The friction between home and homeland led to The Sun Turned Black, an intense and visceral LP characterized by the physicality of sound.
